name: Stadium concourse
desc: The curved underbelly of a stadium - where the crowd noise arrives muffled and someone waits alone.
tags: stadium concourse, curved concrete walkway, exposed ceiling ducts, shuttered kiosks, turnstiles, entry tunnel to the stands, wayfinding signs, strip lighting, crush barriers, litter on the floor, daylight from the tunnel mouth
prose: the curved concrete concourse behind a stadium stand, shuttered kiosks and wayfinding signs beneath strip lights and exposed ducts, with daylight falling in through the tunnel mouth that opens onto the seating
note: Barely photographed next to the bowl itself, so the model constantly tries to escape out into the stands. The tunnel mouth with bright light beyond is the tag that keeps the camera in the concourse while still saying stadium. The curve is essential - a straight concrete corridor reads as a car park instead. Crowd or empty is what sets match day against the night before.
